name: Shuusaku
source:
The girls' dormitory of Shukusei Music Academy is home to some of the most talented young female musicians in Japan.
In such an elite school, appearances count for everything, but behind closed doors the sounds of screams, whimpers, and dull moans can be heard echoing through the halls. The school handy-man, Shuusaku, cleans up after the girls and picks up all their dirty secrets, which he uses to blackmail them into some very un-ladylike private performances.

Shuusaku may get paid to clean up the building, but his true calling is just the opposite- sexually defiling and disgracing the innocent and high-strung musical maestros.

[From [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=746]AniDB[/url]]
translation:
肃正音乐学院的女子宿舍里，住着日本最具才华的一批年轻女性音乐家。
在这所名门学府中，体面高于一切；然而在紧闭的房门背后，尖叫、啜泣与压抑的呻吟却在走廊间回荡。学园杂工臭作在替少女们收拾善后的同时，也暗中抓住了她们一切不可告人的秘密，并以此相要挟，逼迫她们上演一幕幕有失淑女体统的私密演出。

臭作拿薪水本是为了打扫整栋宿舍楼，可他真正的勾当却恰恰相反——肆意玷污并羞辱这些纯洁而紧绷的音乐才女。
